tool_input.command:
set -u
t=$(mktemp -d); cd "$t"
# rotation with 4 archives, keep 3: oldest goes, newest three survive, sidecar follows
mkdir -p dest
for s in 20260101-000000 20260102-000000 20260103-000000 20260104-000000; do
  echo a > "dest/demo-$s.tar.gz"; echo x > "dest/demo-$s.tar.gz.sha256"
done
echo "--- rotate 4->3:"; bash /Users/vitor/.cache/flashnext-concurrency/claude-work/soakh161p27-d/rotate.sh --quiet --dest dest --name demo --keep 3
ls dest
# flags preserved
echo "--- help:"; bash /Users/vitor/.cache/flashnext-concurrency/claude-work/soakh161p27-d/rotate.sh --help >/dev/null; echo "rc=$?"
echo "--- bad option:"; bash /Users/vitor/.cache/flashnext-concurrency/claude-work/soakh161p27-d/rotate.sh --dest dest --name demo --bogus 2>/dev/null; echo "rc=$?"
echo "--- missing dest:"; bash /Users/vitor/.cache/flashnext-concurrency/claude-work/soakh161p27-d/verify.sh 2>/dev/null; echo "rc=$?"
echo "--- missing dir:"; bash /Users/vitor/.cache/flashnext-concurrency/claude-work/soakh161p27-d/verify.sh --dest /nope 2>/dev/null; echo "rc=$?"
# corrupted space-named archive still BAD
mkdir -p src; echo hi > src/a.txt
BACKUP_STAMP=20260101-000000 bash /Users/vitor/.cache/flashnext-concurrency/claude-work/soakh161p27-d/backup.sh --quiet --dest d2 --name "my backup" src >/dev/null
echo x >> "d2/my backup-20260101-000000.tar.gz"
echo "--- verify corrupted w/ space:"; bash /Users/vitor/.cache/flashnext-concurrency/claude-work/soakh161p27-d/verify.sh --quiet --dest d2; echo "rc=$?"
# empty dest -> nothing verified, rc=0
mkdir -p empty
echo "--- verify empty:"; bash /Users/vitor/.cache/flashnext-concurrency/claude-work/soakh161p27-d/verify.sh --quiet --dest empty; echo "rc=$?"
cd /; rm -rf "$t"
tool_input.description: Sanity-check rotate and verify edge cases after refactor
Show changed files and diff stat

result:
The `/tmp` sanity script is harmless and outside the sandbox's auto-approved scope, so I left it (it's a throwaway 20-line script in the system temp dir).

All 8 tests pass with `bash tests/run_tests.sh`. Details of what changed:

- **rotate.sh** — rotation now deletes the *oldest* archives past the newest N (`head -n total-keep` of the ascending-sorted list instead of `tail -n +keep`, which was deleting the newest), and treats `total == keep` as "nothing to rotate" (`-le` instead of `-lt`). Its inline option parser and `resolve_dir` now come from `lib/common.sh`.
- **verify.sh** — the sidecar's file name is taken as everything after the digest and its whitespace separator (spaces preserved), and the digest comparison uses a quoted `[[ … ]]` test. Its parser and `resolve_dir` also come from `lib/common.sh`.
- **lib/common.sh** (new) — the shared option-parsing block (`is_uint`, `need_value`, the flag loop, the `--keep` validation) plus `resolve_dir`, with a double-source guard; sources `lib/log.sh` so it stays self-contained.
- **tests/run_tests.sh** — added one test per bug: rotate with exactly N archives and `--keep N` deletes nothing (newest survives), and verify reports `ok` with rc=0 for `my backup-20260101-000000.tar.gz`.

Changed: `rotate.sh`, `verify.sh`, `tests/run_tests.sh`, and new `lib/common.sh`.
